reporting_design.client_graph: Aggregate direct versus relayed link traffic; show directed machine pairs and A→B/B→A detail. Never add sender TX and receiver RX for the same transferred bytes. Display stale/missing coverage explicitly.
reporting_design.server_graph: Show the account’s gateway/public-port traffic separately; expand relay/proxy coverage only when measured and label the source. Relayed peer traffic can appear in both views and must not be summed into a misleading grand total.
reporting_design.source_requirements: Measure actual routing branches including direct UDP/TURN and WebSocket relay fallback; include reliable stream carriers and route changes. Sampling only session.is_relay at report time cannot accurately attribute bytes across a path switch. Distinguish transport control/overhead from application traffic.
reporting_design.agent_publisher: A bounded independent worker reports authenticated per-instance counter deltas and relationship changes, with idempotent report IDs/retries, low-rate baseline auditing and higher resolution while viewing. Never block forwarding on telemetry.
reporting_design.privacy: Existing account/workspace authorization is authoritative. Verify sender registration and destination visibility, redact external endpoints where appropriate, store metadata/counters only and bound retention.
reporting_design.design_notes: Home Sense source uses compact KPI tiles and paired charts; its chart runs deliberately leave gaps for missing readings. Local browser reference reached login, so no claim of authenticated live Insights viewing.

Responsive two-column phone cards, four-column desktop overview and constrained wide-screen content
